title: I need to get the screen fixed

questions.context: Niamh took her phone to a repair shop; a technician replaced the screen
questions.prompt: Which sentence keeps the roles clear?

options.text: She had her phone screen replaced

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Have something done means another person provides the service

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Have something done means another person provides the service

questions.context: The shop has inspected the phone, but the repair is not complete

options.text: I’ve had it fixed and collected it
They’ve checked it, but they haven’t fixed it yet

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Inspection alone is not a completed repair

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Inspection alone is not a completed repair

questions.context: Cian says, “I’m getting my jacket altered tomorrow”

options.text: He will teach himself to sew tomorrow

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Get something done usually describes an arranged service

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Get something done usually describes an arranged service

questions.context: The technician says the screen should be ready by four

options.text: Could you let me know if that changes?
So you guarantee it will be ready before noon?

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Should be ready gives an expectation, not that different guarantee

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Should be ready gives an expectation, not that different guarantee

questions.context: You want to know the full price before authorising the repair

options.text: Do you like repairing this model?
Does that include parts and labour?

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Parts and labour are the relevant elements of the cost

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Parts and labour are the relevant elements of the cost

questions.context: Niamh has collected her phone and the new screen works
questions.prompt: Which sentence reports the completed service?

options.text: She’s having the screen replaced tomorrow

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Has had reports the service as complete

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Has had reports the service as complete

phrases.displayText: My phone screen cracked yesterday. Do you know a reliable repair shop?
phrases.translation: A tela do meu celular trincou ontem. Você conhece uma assistência técnica confiável?

phrases.displayText: Yes. I had mine repaired at a place near the station
phrases.translation: Sim. Mandei consertar o meu em um lugar perto da estação

phrases.displayText: Did you have to leave it there?
phrases.translation: Você teve que deixar isso lá?

phrases.displayText: Just for the afternoon. They sent me a message when it was ready
phrases.translation: Só para a tarde. Eles me mandaram uma mensagem quando estava pronto

phrases.displayText: That sounds convenient. I need to get my jacket altered as well
phrases.translation: Parece conveniente. Eu também preciso ajustar minha jaqueta

phrases.displayText: There’s a tailor next door. What do you need done?
phrases.translation: Tem um alfaiate ao lado. O que você precisa?

phrases.displayText: The sleeves are too long, so I want to have them shortened
phrases.translation: As mangas estão muito compridas, por isso quero que sejam encurtadas

phrases.displayText: You could get a quote before you leave it
phrases.translation: Você pode obter um orçamento antes de sair

phrases.displayText: Good point. I don’t want to pay more than the jacket cost
phrases.translation: Boa observação. Não quero pagar mais do que o preço da jaqueta

phrases.displayText: Ask about the collection date too. They can get busy
phrases.translation: Pergunte também sobre a data de coleta. Eles podem ficar ocupados

phrases.displayText: I will. I need it back before Friday
phrases.translation: Sim, eu vou. Preciso dele de volta antes de sexta-feira

phrases.displayText: Then I’d call first and check that they can have it ready in time
phrases.translation: Então eu ligaria primeiro para confirmar se eles conseguem deixar pronto a tempo
